environment.description: Same container on ECS Fargate behind ALB. CloudFront distribution sits in front with a custom origin request policy. The distribution has a response headers policy with security headers AND a field-level encryption profile applied to query string parameters. Additionally, the ALB has an associated WAFv2 WebACL with three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override to COUNT, (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match condition on SingleQueryArgument 'name' using pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9 ._-]{0,64}$ with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action at priority 2. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rule groups are evaluating and blocking requests.

config.cdn: CloudFront distribution d-XXXX with origin pointing to ALB
config.network: ALB in private subnet, only CloudFront prefix list in SG inbound
config.cloudfront_origin_access: Custom header X-Origin-Verify with rotated secret, ALB listener rule requires header match
